printer: Stratasys J850, High Quality (14 um), glossy; clear slot = Vero UltraClear
phase_function: g = 0 with reduced scattering sigma_s' = sigma_s (1 - g); equivalent in the diffusive regime and cheaper for volpath than a forward-peaked phase
ior_note: One IOR for every resin. Cured Vero resins differ by ~0.01, which reflects < 0.01 % at normal incidence, but every IOR step becomes an internal dielectric surface in prepare_mitsuba_scene (path depth, noise, dark rims). A single IOR removes all internal interfaces.
source: Physical priors from .devdocs/episodes/viewer_feedback_improve/p1/plan.md (transmittance exp(-sigma_t d); case1 45 % clear colours are opaque in 5 mm). No measured Vero coefficients were available (Elek et al. 2017 / Brunton et al. 2018 not consulted). Not calibration data.

resins.note: opaque within ~0.3 mm; slight warm tint (more blue absorption)
Vero UltraClear (not VeroClear): faint yellow, truly clear
